name: Tiny Farm HQ (this app)
summary: The CEO's operating surface: org chart with personas, chief-of-staff chat routed to any team member, the living entity gallery, the program report, and the decision inbox that mirrors the designer queue. Runs locally and starts at boot.
requirements: Runs on localhost with zero external dependencies
Starts automatically at boot (systemd user service)
Org chart with every persona browsable and chattable
Entity gallery with animated sprites and asset/code/sound references
Program report with per-project pages (requirements, status, plan)
Decision inbox parsed live from the designer queue doc
Chat keeps taking work when the 5-hour token window is dry (queued, then answered on its own)
Deploying the game to the tablet is a button, and works with no model in the loop
current_status: Shipped 2026-09-01, then rebuilt the same day into the command center: derived pillar signals (git/CI/traces/tags — nothing hand-maintained), the Eye of Sauron queue, pillar pages with living demos, the playtest viewer, the in-app verification runner, and the chief-of-staff brief. 2026-09-02 added the intake queue: an out-of-tokens window now parks chat requests and answers them when it reopens, instead of the page going dead. The same day, deploying to the tablet became a button on the Engineering & QA pillar: it runs tools/deploy_android.sh, narrates each step, and answers its own failures in plain English, so a build reaches the device on the days the token budget is spent. Next natural increments: a KPI page once there is revenue, and richer per-persona demo automation.
